HEIC decoder: heic-to 1.6.7 by Hopper Gee
License: LGPL-3.0; retained in LICENSE. This separate module is unmodified.
Package: https://registry.npmjs.org/heic-to/-/heic-to-1.6.7.tgz
Source: https://github.com/hoppergee/heic-to/tree/v1.6.7

Includes libheif 1.23.7 and libde265 1.0.16 compiled to JavaScript.
Sources and their copyright/license files are provided in SOURCES.tar.gz.
https://github.com/strukturag/libheif/tree/v1.23.7
https://github.com/strukturag/libde265/tree/v1.0.16
The heic-to README and esbuild.mjs in SOURCES.tar.gz describe its build.
The module can be replaced independently of the website code.

The decoder and its worker are loaded only for a raw HEIC file when native
browser decoding is unavailable. JPEG, PNG, WebP and AVIF use the normal path.
Photos are decoded on the device; the decoder contacts no conversion service.

SHA-256 of unmodified heic-to.js: 891a8087d75c3ca093427a643c677b10fc7f9c4f9181583dcb989bc805e75f6e
